en_title: 'Final Nail in the Coffin': Xbox Price Rises Revealed, Leaving Fans Stunned as Series X/S Spike By More Than a Third in Europe
subtitle: 这下真贵了
opus_summary: 微软将欧洲XBOX主机价格上调超三成，Series S与X售价最高达619英镑(约合人民币5639元)和669英镑(约合人民币6095元)。微软称存储与内存成本上涨是主因。

paragraphs.en: Microsoft has increased the price of its consoles by more than a third in Europe, leaving fans stunned at how much an Xbox Series X/S now costs.
paragraphs.cn: 微软已将其主机在欧洲的价格上调超过三分之一，XBOX Series X/S如今的售价之高让粉丝瞠目结舌。

paragraphs.en: While these price rises are not a surprise — Microsoft announced they were coming back in June — the exact pricing for Xbox Series X and S in mainland Europe and the UK remained under wraps until now.
paragraphs.cn: 虽然这次涨价并不意外——微软早在6月就宣布将会涨价——但欧洲大陆和英国地区XBOX Series X与S的具体价格直到现在才揭晓。

paragraphs.en: In the U.S., Microsoft previously stated that the 512GB Series S would rise by $100, while 1TB Series models would rise by $150 — increases that equate to around £74 and £111. The 2TB model will be discontinued completely, meanwhile — presumably because it would have become too expensive to be worthwhile making.
paragraphs.cn: 在美国，微软此前表示512GB版Series S将涨价100美元(约合人民币676元)，1TB版Series则将涨价150美元(约合人民币1014元)，折合约74英镑(约合人民币674元)和111英镑(约合人民币1011元)。同时，2TB型号将彻底停产——推测是因为它的价格会高到不值得继续生产。

paragraphs.en: But in the UK and mainland Europe, the actual price rises in pounds and euros are much steeper. The 512GB Series S has jumped from £299 to £429, an increase of £130, while its 1TB model has increased from £349 to £519, a leap of £170.
paragraphs.cn: 但在英国和欧洲大陆，以英镑和欧元计算的实际涨幅要大得多。512GB版Series S已从299英镑(约合人民币2724元)涨至429英镑(约合人民币3908元)，增加130英镑(约合人民币1184元)；1TB型号则从349英镑(约合人民币3179元)涨至519英镑(约合人民币4728元)，增加170英镑(约合人民币1549元)。

paragraphs.en: Worse still are the increases for Series X models, with the 1TB Digital up from £449 to £619 (£170), but the 1TB Disc model up from £449 to £669 — whopping 48% increase, and £220 difference.
paragraphs.cn: Series X型号的涨幅更惊人：1TB数字版从449英镑(约合人民币4090元)涨至619英镑(约合人民币5639元)（增加170英镑(约合人民币1549元)），1TB光驱版则从449英镑(约合人民币4090元)涨至669英镑(约合人民币6095元)——涨幅高达48%，增加220英镑(约合人民币2004元)。

paragraphs.en: Fans have slammed the huge changes, which are far higher than expected. "Final nail in the coffin," wrote one user on the video game forum ResetEra . "Great strategy, that'll definitely lead to more sales," said another. "There is no way in 2026 I would be paying nearly £700 for a Series X with a disc drive," wrote a third.
paragraphs.cn: 粉丝纷纷抨击这次远超预期的大幅调整。一名用户在电子游戏论坛ResetEra上写道：「棺材上的最后一根钉子。」另一人说：「真是绝妙的策略，肯定能带来更多销量。」第三人写道：「2026年我绝不可能为带光驱的Series X支付近700英镑(约合人民币6377元)。」

paragraphs.en: "Still trying to process how a console that was sold for €499 almost six years ago is now €799," noted another fan. "The Series S 1TB is now €100 more expensive than the Series X at launch. This is just mindblowing."
paragraphs.cn: 另一位粉丝感叹道：「我还在消化这样一个事实：一台将近6年前售价499欧元(约合人民币3887元)的主机，如今竟然卖到799欧元(约合人民币6224元)。」他还说：「1TB版Series S如今比Series X发售时贵了100欧元(约合人民币779元)。简直令人难以置信。」

paragraphs.en: Back in June, Microsoft blamed this latest set of price rises as the result of console storage and memory prices having "increased by more than 2.5x," with another "doubling by the fall of 2027" expected.
paragraphs.cn: 今年6月，微软将这轮最新涨价归咎于主机存储和内存价格「上涨了超过2.5倍」，并预计到2027年秋季还会「再翻一倍」。

paragraphs.en: "The entire consumer electronics industry is struggling with the current components crisis, but the effects are particularly hard on consoles," Microsoft wrote. Unlike phones, computers, speakers, and other consumer devices, consoles are typically not sold at a profit, but instead for less than they cost to make."
paragraphs.cn: 「整个消费电子行业都在当前的组件危机中挣扎，但这种影响对主机尤其严重。」微软写道。与手机、电脑、音箱等其他消费电子产品不同，主机通常不是以盈利为目的销售，而是以低于制造成本的价格出售。

paragraphs.en: The anouncement of the Xbox console price rises comes ahead of the release of GTA 6 in November, which is expected to increase demand for PS5 and Xbox Series X and S significantly. However, there are concerns that neither Sony nor Microsoft will be able to meet the demand caused by the release of GTA 6, with the AI boom making it particularly hard for hardware manufacturers not only to source components, but to release products at affordable prices.
paragraphs.cn: XBOX主机涨价的消息公布于11月《GTA6》发售前夕，该作预计将大幅拉高PS5和XBOX Series的需求。然而，外界担忧索尼和微软可能都无法满足《GTA6》所带来的需求，因为人工智能热潮正让硬件厂商不仅难以采购组件，更难以用亲民的价格推出产品。

paragraphs.en: Earlier this year, Xbox CEO Asha Sharma said the spiralling cost of new and existing consoles would require "radically different business models" over the coming generation. She added that the industry had "reached a point where it will be hard to imagine" mass audiences still being able to afford "thousands of dollars" for a new console generation.
paragraphs.cn: 今年早些时候，XBOX首席执行官Asha Sharma表示，新一代主机和现有主机不断攀升的成本将要求行业在未来这一代采用「彻底不同的商业模式」。她还说，整个行业已经「到了很难想象」大众仍能为新一代主机支付「数千美元」的地步。

paragraphs.en: The current PS5 and Xbox Series X and S generation of consoles have seen price increases rather than cost savings. Sony itself raised the price of PS5 consoles back in March , blaming "continued pressures in the global economic landscape." Nintendo has also not been immune, and recently acknowledged it would up the price of Switch 2, just over a year after its arrival. And Valve has bemoaned its struggle to release Steam Machine at the price it had initially hoped , instead having to go for an eye-watering $1,049.
paragraphs.cn: 当前这一代PS5和XBOX Series主机都经历了涨价而非降价。索尼早在今年3月就已上调PS5售价，理由是「全球经济形势持续承压」，任天堂同样未能幸免，近期也承认将在Switch 2上市一年多一点后提价。Valve亦苦恼于无法以最初期望的价格推出Steam Machine，最终不得不定出1049美元(约合人民币7091元)这样令人肉疼的价格。
